visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A light brown, medium-sized dog with a blue collar stands in an unpaved backyard area featuring banana trees and sparse grass. The dog is seen from a high angle, looking back over its shoulder. Large text overlays appear on the center of the frame. (2) The dog remains stationary, turning its head to look directly at the camera. The background shows a shaded area with trees and a concrete walkway in the distance. (3) The dog lowers its head to the base of a banana plant and performs a physical digging motion with its snout and paws in the dry dirt. (4) The dog stops digging, turns its body, and walks toward the camera. (5) The camera angle shifts to a close-up of a small hole in the ground under the tree, revealing a dark red, square piece of food. (6) The dog's head quickly dips into the hole, grabs the piece of food with its mouth, and turns away. (7) The dog walks into a sunlit grassy area and begins a chewing motion with its mouth while looking toward the camera. (8) The video concludes with a solid pink screen featuring white text and a brand logo.

The video follows the dog 'Okra' as it attempts to look innocent while actually having hidden a piece of meat in the ground, culminating in a comedic 'catch' and the dog's subsequent enjoyment of its prize.
